items.event_time_ist: depression expected within 2 days of NHC outlook issued 11:00 AM PDT, Oct 12 (11:30 PM IST, Oct 12)
items.source_name: NHC Tropical Weather Outlook (via El Dorado Weather)
items.summary: NHC's Tropical Weather Outlook (11 AM PDT, Oct 12) raised the broad low-pressure system (EP93) several hundred miles south-southwest of Guatemala to a 90% formation chance through both 48 hours and 7 days (up from 80%/90% at 5 AM PDT). A tropical depression is expected to form well south of southern Mexico in the next two days while the system moves west-northwestward at around 10 mph. A 1009 mb low has formed near 08N93W with a large area of showers and thunderstorms.
items.title: New tropical depression expected to form south of southern Mexico (EP93)

items.event_time_ist: NHC Advisory 21 issued 8:00 AM PDT (8:30 PM IST), Oct 12
items.source_name: NHC Hurricane Simon Public Advisory (via Ventusky)
items.summary: NHC Advisory 21 kept Simon at 110 mph (Cat 2), ~55 mi WSW of Cabo Corrientes crawling NW at 3 mph, and Mexico downgraded coastal warnings: hurricane warning lowered to hurricane watch from north of Cabo Corrientes to El Roblito, and hurricane warning lowered to tropical storm warning from Playa Perula north to Cabo Corrientes. Remaining: hurricane warning for Las Islas Marias only; hurricane watch north of Cabo Corrientes to Bahia Tempehuaya; tropical storm warning Playa Perula to Cabo Corrientes. NHC's 16:05 UTC discussion forecasts a northeastward turn and movement inland across Sinaloa on Thursday, with additional 2-4 inches of rain (isolated 8 inches) over Colima, Jalisco, Nayarit and Sinaloa through early Thursday and isolated storm totals up to 30 inches possible over Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco — life-threatening flooding and mudslides.
items.title: Simon: coastal warnings downgraded; landfall now expected Thursday in Sinaloa

items.summary: As of Monday morning, Oct 12, about 146,000 structures had no power in Florida (concentrated in Escambia and Santa Rosa counties) and around 20,000 in Alabama, per PowerOutage.us trackers — down from a ~950,000-customer peak (Edison Electric Institute). FPL, the hardest-hit utility (435,000 outages), now expects 85% restoration by end of Monday — a downward revision of its initial 95% estimate — with hardest-hit Escambia/Santa Rosa areas back online Tuesday, Oct 13. Alabama Power says 95% of affected customers are restored, with longer work in heavily damaged areas. Pensacola's boil-water notice remains in effect.
items.title: Isaias recovery: ~146k still without power in Florida, ~20k in Alabama; FPL trims Monday estimate

items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy authorized an emergency exchange of up to 4 million barrels of crude from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve on Oct 10 — up to 2 million barrels each for ExxonMobil and BP America to keep refineries running, to be returned in 2027 with premium barrels. By Friday afternoon, about 71.5% of daily Gulf oil production (~1.46 million bpd) and 58.8% of natural gas were shut in, with 100+ platforms evacuated and 8 rigs evacuated or moved.
items.title: DOE authorized 4M-barrel SPR emergency exchange after Isaias shut in Gulf production
